title: 第3章 基本呼吸法！丧尸！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始

第(1/3)页

罗兰问道：“娴妹你获得词条了吗？”

“嗯。”王娴微微颔首：“我获得了【药剂精通】这个词条，能让我制作药剂的成功率增加10%！”

“这个词条，很不错！”罗兰闻言有些惊讶，旋即便为王娴感到欣喜，如果王娴掌握了制造药剂的能力，那她日后在聚集地也算是一方人物了！

王娴也十分意外：“我也没有想到，我居然会获得这个词条！”

“不说这些了，罗兰哥，现在我们已经获得了数据面板，走，去找我父亲！”

说完，王娴便拉着罗兰离开了教室。

走出教室，外面是昏沉沉、灰蒙蒙，仿佛笼罩着一层灰气的天空。

不知道从什么地方散发的光芒，让天空微微发亮，不至于让整个聚集地陷入彻底的黑暗之中。

罗兰和王娴快步走在街道上，很快便来到了王娴家中。

“你们回来了。”

王叔坐在客厅中已经老的掉皮的沙发上，双手无力的自然垂落，看向罗兰两人，目光中期待之色怎么也掩饰不住：“怎么样？有没有获得词条？”

“我获得了【药剂精通】这个词条，罗兰哥没有获得词条。”王娴惋惜道。

“【药剂精通】？”王叔闻言一愣，旋即一脸惊喜：“这是个好词条！有了这个词条，你这次的试炼世界就安全了！”

“可惜，罗兰没有获得任何词条！”王叔此刻眼眸不禁闪过一丝失望之色，眉头都下意识的皱了起来。

王娴说道：“以罗兰哥的实力，就算没有获得词条，也有机会通过试炼世界，如果能和其他人汇合，那生存几率就更大了！”

“对了，父亲，你之前说我们一旦觉醒了数据面板就传授我们【基本呼吸法】，现在我们已经觉醒了，是时候传授给我们了！”

王娴一脸期待看着王叔。

王叔此刻微微点头：“之前不传授你们，是因为你们没有数据面板，如果得到这门呼吸法，然后忍不住修炼起来，那后果就太严重了！”

罗兰和王娴坐下，默默听着王叔说话。

王叔说的内容，都是聚集地任何人都知道的东西。

他们在没有被蓝星意志开启数据面板之前，无法修炼任何的超凡能力，一旦修炼，没有任何效果都是最好的结果，严重的，身体严重受创，尿血都是轻的。

唯有开启了数据面板之后，他们才可以说是脱胎换骨，有了能修炼超凡能力的本质！

而且，任何一种能被人修炼的超凡能力，都十分珍贵！

罗兰父母当年，都没有获得这种东西。

“罗兰，当年我在一个骑士横行的碎片世界中，得到了一门【基本呼吸法】，现在就交给你！”

“修炼到最高境界，能将人体深处的潜能引导出来……”

“可惜，那个世界碎片太小，找不到传说中凌驾于一切骑士之上的巫师，否则......”

王叔摇了摇头，旋即用眼神示意王娴将记载了【基本呼吸法】的本子拿过来。

“罗兰哥，给你。”王娴很快将一本书籍交到了罗兰手上。

Roland asked: "Mei Xian, have you obtained the entry?"

"Yes." Wang Xian nodded slightly: "I obtained the entry [Poison Mastery], which can increase my success rate of making potions by 10%!"

"This entry is very good!" Roland was a little surprised when he heard this, and immediately felt happy for Wang Xian. If Wang Xian mastered the ability to make potions, she would be considered a figure in the gathering place in the future!

Wang Xian was also very surprised: "I didn't expect that I would actually get this entry!"

"Stop talking about this, Brother Luolan, now that we have obtained the data panel, let's go find my father!"

After saying that, Wang Xian took Roland and left the classroom.

Walking out of the classroom, it was gloomy and gray outside, as if the sky was covered with a layer of gray.

The light emanating from nowhere made the sky slightly brighter, preventing the entire gathering place from falling into complete darkness.

Roland and Wang Xian walked quickly on the street and soon arrived at Wang Xian's home.

"You are back."

Uncle Wang was sitting on the old and peeling sofa in the living room, his hands hanging down naturally as he looked at Roland and the two of them. He couldn't hide the expectant look in his eyes: "How is it? Did you get the entry?"

"I got the entry for [Poison Mastery], but Brother Luo Lan didn't get the entry." Wang Xian said regretfully.

"[Proficiency in Potion]?" Uncle Wang was stunned when he heard this, and then said with a look of surprise: "This is a good entry! With this entry, your trial world will be safe this time!"

"It's a pity that Roland didn't get any entries!" Uncle Wang couldn't help but have a hint of disappointment in his eyes at this moment, and his brows frowned subconsciously.

Wang Xian said: "With Brother Luo Lan's strength, even if he doesn't get the entry, he still has a chance to pass the trial world. If he can join up with others, the chance of survival will be even greater!"

"By the way, father, you said before that you would teach us the [Basic Breathing Technique] once we awakened from the data panel. Now that we have awakened, it is time to teach it to us!"

Wang Xian looked at Uncle Wang expectantly.

Uncle Wang nodded slightly at this moment: "I didn't teach you before because you didn't have a data panel. If you get this breathing method and can't help but practice it, the consequences will be too serious!"

Roland and Wang Xian sat down and listened silently to Uncle Wang's words.

What Uncle Wang said was something everyone at the gathering knew.

They cannot practice any extraordinary abilities before the data panel is opened by the will of Blue Star. Once they practice, no effect is the best result. In serious cases, the body is seriously injured and blood in the urine is light.

Only after opening the data panel can they be said to be completely reborn and have the essence to cultivate extraordinary abilities!

Moreover, any extraordinary ability that can be cultivated is very precious!

Roland's parents did not have such a thing back then.

"Roland, back then in a fragmented world where knights were rampant, I obtained a [Basic Breathing Technique]. I'll leave it to you now!"

"Cultivation to the highest level can guide the potential deep in the human body..."

"It's a pity that the fragment of the world is too small to find the legendary wizard who is superior to all knights, otherwise..."

Uncle Wang shook his head and immediately motioned with his eyes to Wang Xian to bring over the book containing the [Basic Breathing Techniques].

"Brother Luo Lan, here you go." Wang Xian quickly handed a book to Luo Lan.
